# Native diagram examples

`pele-native-examples.json` contains all 91 Mermaid fences from the PicoMarkdownView-HTML skill reference, skill and demo documents named in each fixture's `origin`. They cover 32 diagram families. The six `usecase-beta` and `agentflow-beta` examples use the pinned Pele runtime; the other 85 use Mermaid.js. Preserve the original source when updating fixtures.

The fixture suite checks that examples render, rather than comparing pixels or promising complete syntax equivalence. The source project's MIT notice is included in `static/pico-runtime/pele/NativeBridge-LICENSE.txt`.
